exposure: Number of previous Cesarean sections (Group A: no previous C-section, Group B: history of C-section)
application of a patch containing Allium cepa and allantoin
Patch containing Allium cepa and allantoin
outcome: Scar appearance (assessed using digital photographs and the Patient and Observer Scar Assessment Scale (POSAS))
finding: Treatment with a patch containing Allium cepa and allantoin for 4 weeks improved pigmentation, relief, and pliability of Cesarean section scars in women with a history of C-section.
